title: Server handles connections serially (single-threaded accept loop)
evidence: Sources/BooksServer/main.swift:76-82 — accept loop calls serve() inline with no threading, so one slow client blocks all others
suggestion: Dispatch each accepted client to a concurrent queue/thread if concurrency matters; not required by the spec

title: ?author= filter is exact and case-sensitive
evidence: Sources/BooksCore/BooksCore.swift:57 — WHERE author = ? uses exact equality; documented in README.md
suggestion: Consider LIKE/case-insensitive matching if partial author search is desired; current behavior satisfies the spec
